Great! It sounds like you're interested in performing anomaly detection on your dataset. To get started, could you provide more details about your dataset? Specifically, I would need to know:

- The type of data you have (e.g., numerical, categorical, time-series).
- The file format(s) your dataset is in (e.g., CSV, Excel, JSON).
- Any specific requirements or constraints you might have regarding explainability or model performance.

Once I have this information, we can proceed with uploading your dataset and setting up the anomaly detection process.
